title: If–then plan: iraada kab action banta hai?

events.detail: Manifest और स्थानीय कार्य-निर्देशिका बनाई गई; कोई मीडिया अभी उत्पन्न नहीं।
planned → researched. Source record separates construct definition, aggregated evidence, physical-activity heterogeneity, and non-guarantee boundaries.
researched → verified. All central claims retain conditions: specific cue-response link, strong underlying goal, feasible action, and behaviour-specific evidence variation.
verified → scripted. Hindi script distinguishes abstract goals from cue-response if-then plans and preserves heterogeneous-evidence, feasibility, and non-guarantee limits.
scripted → voiced. Hindi narration is 56.72 seconds; captions use transcription-aligned timing. Script preserves if-then plan limits and avoids a guaranteed-outcome claim.
voiced → rendered. Rendered original deterministic three-scene cue-to-action visuals; no pending fresh-image result was included in the final package.
